dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar PC-based COBOL (file paths use Windows backslash C:\IHCC\COBOL\, LINAGE clause, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE, EVALUATE, 88-level condition names with VALUE THRU). Student assignment context suggests a PC COBOL environment such as GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus Personal COBOL.

purpose.domain_detail: Student programming assignment for Iowa Hills Community College (IHCC) COBOL course; generates a pop (soda) sales report for the Albia Soccer Club fundraiser
purpose.summary: This program reads a sequential file of pop sales records for the Albia Soccer Club fundraiser, validates each record (checking name, address, state, zip, pop type, quantity, and team), and produces two reports: a valid sales report with deposit and total calculations per record, and an error report for invalid records. It also prints grand totals by pop type and by team.

notable_features: LINAGE clause with AT EOP for page overflow handling
FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE for dynamic date stamping
EVALUATE statement for pop type and team branching
88-level condition names with VALUE THRU ranges
Validation routine using GO TO exit pattern (PERFORM THRU 2100-X)
Multiple output files (valid report + error report)
Deposit calculation varies by state (IA/NE/WI vs MI vs others)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric accumulators
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at ~16000 chars; the last visible line is a partial MOVE statement ('MO'). The IHCC in the file path likely refers to Iowa Hills Community College. Tab characters appear in the COMPANY-TITLE-LINE and ERR-COMPANY-TITLE-LINE sections (mixed indentation), but overall format is fixed-column COBOL-85.
